settings.heading: Shamballa universe
settings.text:
Our headquater and flagship store is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. When entering the flagship store we aim to surround our guests with a feeling of peace, calmness and kindness, not to mention quality and uniqueness. All furniture is handmade and when entering the store, a 300kg majestic lingam stone will be one of the first symbols you see. Usually, the shiva lingam is depicted with Yoni, it's feminine counterpart. Together they symbolize the union between the feminine and the masculine that recreate the whole existence.

At Shamballa Universe, we invite you to not just experience our exceptional jewelry but to immerse yourself in a world where the union of artistry and spirituality takes center stage.

settings.heading: Personalized Shopping Haven
settings.text:
In our flagship store, the essence of a peaceful shopping haven extends beyond just product protection. We pride ourselves on delivering an elevated experience that harmonizes high-end jewelry with personalized and professional service. Explore our meticulously crafted pieces, and if your heart's desire doesn't reside among them, our artisans are poised to create bespoke items tailored to your exact wishes.

You can shop here with complete confidence, knowing that your journey transcends mere transactions; it's a serene and personalized immersion into the world of luxury.
